title: Can a Next.js dev app reflect externally written files and do lock-protected write-backs?
statement: Can a Next.js development app reliably reflect artifact files written by an EXTERNAL process, and perform lock-protected status write-backs, without relying on HMR, stale server state, or framework-owned caching?
notes: #100 recorded that the walking skeleton is framework-free and that #5's Next.js choice is therefore untested — with React's state model against #78's lock named as the part most likely to bite. This is the narrow, falsifiable form of that debt. #12 puts the agent in a terminal that knows nothing about the dev server, so every artifact write is external by construction. Answered by reading first, then validation.
